title: Patch: an AI deck that leans on no set keeps its Units floor when its theme has few or no Units
plan_in_issue:
## Goal

Every deck `build_ai_deck` deals with no `lean_set` holds at least `ceil(size × AI_DECK.min_unit_share)` Units and its theme's floor whenever the cards left can meet both, as SPEC §9.9 and R1370 call these hard floors. The fix moves no other deal. A deck that held both floors on `main` is dealt card for card as before, and no deal takes an extra rng draw. It also brings:

- ruling R4784000, which amends R1370's last paragraph;
- per-deck floor tests for unleaned decks over every theme tag and every quality-gate deck;
- corrections to the doc lines that said unleaned deals never move.

Planner's prototype of exactly this design, measured against `main`:

- **Floors:** of 29,700 unleaned decks (every theme at 25/30/35 cards, AI and player decks at each tier, and every gate/fixture/tuning deck of 100 games per matchup), 1,779 were short. After the fix none is short.
- **What moved:** the decks that moved are exactly those 1,779. No rng cursor moved.
- **Pins:** none of the 4 existing pins moved.
- **Tests and checks:** the four new tests fail on `main` and pass after the fix. The whole `jackioh-ai` suite passes (including `ai_slow`, the daily sweep pin and the tools gate smokes), and so do `spec check`, clippy and fmt.

## Steps

1. **`deck.rs`, `weighted_index`.** Change the signature to `fn weighted_index(weights: &[f64], roll: f64) -> Option<usize>`.
   - Body: `let at = roll * total;` replaces `let roll = rng.next() * total;`, and the loop compares `at < cumulative`. Same float arithmetic, so the same index.
   - Doc: "One index into `weights` for `roll`, one draw of the rng in [0, 1): chosen with probability proportional to its weight, the last when the roll runs past the end, `None` for an empty list."

2. **`deck.rs`, split `narrow_leaning`.** Rename its body to a new fn after it, with this signature:
   `fn floor_takes(remaining: &[&CardDef], slots_left: i32, owed: [i32; 3], theme: Option<&str>, lean: Option<SetName>) -> Option<[bool; CLASSES]>`
   - Body unchanged except three returns: `return remaining.to_vec();` (the `needed < slots_left` case) becomes `return None;`; the final `return remaining.iter().zip(&classes)…collect();` becomes `return Some(takes);`; the trailing `remaining.to_vec()` becomes `None`.
   - Move `narrow_leaning`'s doc onto it, reworded "the classes of card the next pick may take, `None` when it may take any…".
   - `narrow_leaning` keeps its signature. Its doc becomes "R1370: the cards the next pick of a leaning deck may take, those of the classes `floor_takes` keeps." Its body:
   ```rust
   match floor_takes(remaining, slots_left, owed, theme, lean) {
       None => remaining.to_vec(),
       Some(takes) => remaining.iter().copied().filter(|def| takes[class_of(def, theme, lean)]).collect(),
   }
   ```

3. **`deck.rs`, add `unleaned_redraw` right after `floor_takes`:**
   ```rust
   /// R4784000: the cards a deck that leans on no set draws its pick again from, with the same roll, when
   /// `picked` would leave the theme's and the units' floors (`owed`, the leaned set's owing 0) out of
   /// reach: those of `eligible` that `floor_takes` keeps, or of `remaining` when `eligible` holds none.
   /// `None` when `picked` keeps them, so a deck that held both floors deals as it always did.
   fn unleaned_redraw<'a>(
       remaining: &[&'a CardDef],
       eligible: &[&'a CardDef],
       picked: &CardDef,
       slots_left: i32,
       owed: [i32; 3],
       theme: Option<&str>,
   ) -> Option<Vec<&'a CardDef>> {
       let takes = floor_takes(remaining, slots_left, owed, theme, None)?;
       if takes[class_of(picked, theme, None)] {
           return None;
       }
       let keeps = |def: &&CardDef| takes[class_of(def, theme, None)];
       let again: Vec<&CardDef> = eligible.iter().copied().filter(keeps).collect();
       if again.is_empty() {
           Some(remaining.iter().copied().filter(keeps).collect())
       } else {
           Some(again)
       }
   }
   ```

4. **`deck.rs`, `build_ai_deck_traced` loop.** Keep `narrow_unleaned` and the `eligible` computation unchanged.
   - Turn the `let weights = eligible.iter().map(|def| { … }).collect();` closure into `let weight_of = |def: &CardDef| -> f64 { …same body… };`.
   - Then replace everything up to `let Some(chosen) = …` with:
   ```rust
   let weights: Vec<f64> = eligible.iter().map(|def| weight_of(def)).collect();
   // R4784000: one roll per pick, a pick drawn again included, so the rng stops where it always did.
   let roll = rng.next();
   let mut chosen = weighted_index(&weights, roll).and_then(|at| eligible.get(at).copied());
   // With no theme the units' narrowing alone already keeps the one floor, so only a themed deck
   // can need a pick drawn again.
   if lean.is_none()
       && theme.is_some()
       && let Some(picked) = chosen
       && let Some(again) = unleaned_redraw(
           &remaining,
           &eligible,
           picked,
           slots_left,
           [0, theme_needed - tally.themed, units_needed - tally.units],
           theme.as_deref(),
       )
   {
       let weights: Vec<f64> = again.iter().map(|def| weight_of(def)).collect();
       chosen = weighted_index(&weights, roll).and_then(|at| again.get(at).copied());
   }
   let Some(chosen) = chosen else {
   ```
   - The panic body after it is unchanged. Run `cargo fmt`; it re-indents the closure body, which is expected.

5. **`deck.rs`, doc comments.**
   - Header, after line 7 (`…before the units).`), add: "A deck that leans on no set keeps the narrowing it always had, and a pick that would leave its theme's and its units' floors out of reach together is drawn again from the same roll (R4784000), so a deck that held both deals as it always did."
   - `lean_set` doc: "`None` deals exactly the deck it always did." becomes "`None` deals the deck it always did wherever that deck held the theme's and the units' floors (R4784000)."
   - `narrow_unleaned` doc becomes: "The narrowing a deck that leans on no set has always had: once the theme cards still owed reach the slots left only theme cards are eligible, and once the units still owed do, only the units among those (when there are any). It weighs each floor alone; `unleaned_redraw` keeps the two together."

6. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs`, `every_floor_holds`.**
   - Change the parameter `lean: SetName` to `lean: Option<SetName>`.
   - Set `literal["leanSet"]` only when it is `Some`.
   - `let leaned = lean.map(|lean| ungated_lean(Some(lean), &gate_of(&literal)).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!(…same…)));`
   - `let lean_label = lean.map_or_else(|| "none".to_string(), |set| set.to_string());` and use `{lean_label}` in the seed format. This keeps every leaning seed's label byte-identical.
   - Wrap the lean-floor `assert!` in `if let Some(leaned) = leaned { … }`.
   - Update its doc ("leaning on `lean`, or on no set when `None`").
   - In the 7 existing call sites, `newest` becomes `Some(newest)`, `set` becomes `Some(set)`, and `pick.resolve()` becomes `Some(pick.resolve())`.

   - Change `; 4] = [` to `; 5] = [` and append this entry (dealt on `main`, where it held 12 of 12 Units):

     - cursor `25`;
     - deck `"core-043", "classicplus-044", "core-019", "core-087", "classic-012", "classicplus-039", "classic-077", "classicplus-035", "classic-080", "classic-053", "classic-067", "core-045", "classic-048", "classicplus-038", "core-071", "classicplus-040", "classicplus-049", "classicplus-054", "classic-027", "classic-003", "classicplus-056", "classicplus-057", "classic-016", "classic-024", "classicplus-055"`.
   - Add to the comment above `let pins`: "#4784 adds the Book pin, a theme holding no Unit, dealt before R4784000 where it held the units' floor, so R4784000 leaves it as it was".

8. **Same file, four tests** in `mod r1370_a_deck_that_leans_on_a_set` before `r1370_lean_set_reads_and_writes_as_lean_set_naming_the_set` (see Tests).

9. **`spec/rulings/R4784000.md`.** Front matter:
   - `id: R4784000`
   - `title: "A random deck that leans on no set keeps its theme's floor and its units' together (issue #4784)"`
   - `cards: "§9.9, R1370, R4513000"`
   - `proven_in: [crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs]`

   Text, two paragraphs:
   - (a) [[§9.9]]'s `build_ai_deck` keeps a theme's floor (`themeMinShare`) and the units' (`minUnitShare`) together for a deck that leans on no set, as [[R1370]] keeps three together for one that leans.
     - Each pick is drawn as it always was, from one roll: the theme's narrowing, then the units', each when its own slots run out.
     - When that card would leave the two floors out of reach, it is drawn again from the same roll and the same weights. The cards it is drawn from are those of that narrowing that [[R1370]]'s fewest way of meeting the floors (the leaned set owing nothing) would take, or all the cards left that it would take when the narrowing holds none. When the slots cannot meet both, the theme's floor goes first, as in R1370's order.
     - Why: the units' narrowing never counted the theme cards still owed. So a theme with few or no Units (Book, Fruit, Drone Core, Jelly Bean, Mineral and Call to Chaos hold none; KY and Terminus too few) lost the units' floor in 262 of 9,000 of the AI's own decks, some of the quality gates' among them.
   - (b) Only a card that would cost a floor is drawn again, and a deck dealt such a card lost a floor before (the units' floor in every deck measured). So every deck that held both deals card for card as before, and the rng stops where it always did.
     - Measured over 29,700 unleaned decks: the 1,779 short decks are dealt again and hold the floor, and nothing else moves. No pinned test, practice, e2e seed or the practice-claim fixture held a short deck.
     - 16 decks of the `gate:v3` full run are dealt again: ai-vs-random 4, 7, 52, 78, 82; ai-vs-greedy 9, 12, 19, 22 (both seats), 24, 37, 50; hard-vs-easy 5, 13, 33. The measured rates ([[R4513000]]) stand.
     - It amends [[R1370]]'s last paragraph.

10. **`spec/pending/4784.md`.** One paragraph: `**[[R4784000]] A random deck that leans on no set keeps its theme's floor and its units' together (issue #4784, <today's date>)**: `, then (a)'s cause, the fix and (b)'s "only the short decks move, 16 in the `gate:v3` full run" in three or four sentences, ending "It amends [[R1370]]'s last paragraph and edits [[§9.9]]."

11. **`spec/rulings/R1370.md`, last paragraph.** Change "so no golden trace, seed-pinned test or replay moves." to "so no golden trace, seed-pinned test or replay moved. Since [[R4784000]], a card that would leave the theme's and the units' floors out of reach together is drawn again from the same roll, so a deck that lost the units' floor is dealt again and every other deck deals as before."

12. **`spec/09-architecture.md`, §9.9 Decks.** After "between 100 and 1,000 deals ([[R1679000]])." insert: "The draw's units' floor (`AI_DECK.minUnitShare`) and a theme's (`AI_DECK.themeMinShare`) are hard floors, kept together whenever the cards left can meet both, the theme's first when they cannot ([[R4784000]])."

13. **`crates/ai/README.md`.**
    - Heading: add `R4784000` after `R1370`.
    - Change "absent, the draw is exactly the one it always was." to "absent, the draw is the one it always was, except that a card which would leave the theme's and the units' floors out of reach together is drawn again from the same roll (R4784000), so only a deck that lost the units' floor deals differently."

14. **`docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` l.760-761.** Change "absent, the draw is exactly the pre-R1370 one)" to "absent, the pre-R1370 draw, a pick that would cost the theme's and the units' floors drawn again from the same roll, R4784000)".

## Tests

All four new tests go in `crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs`, module `r1370_a_deck_that_leans_on_a_set`.

- `r4784000_without_a_lean_set_every_theme_keeps_its_floor_and_the_units_floor_on_every_deck_at_every_tier`
  - Setup: `banned` = `SHADOW_BAN_IDS` as `String`s, `let themes = themes(&banned, AI_DECK_GATED_SETS);` and `assert!(themes.iter().any(|(tag, _)| tag == "Book"), "{themes:?}");`.
  - For `difficulty in [Difficulty::Easy, Difficulty::Medium, Difficulty::Hard]` with `h = AI_DIFFICULTY[difficulty]`, and for each `(tag, in_pool)`: `every_floor_holds(h.deck_size, json!({ "manaCap": h.mana_cap }), None, Some((tag, *in_pool)), 50)`.
- `r4784000_without_a_lean_set_a_rolled_theme_or_none_keeps_the_units_floor_on_every_deck_at_every_tier`
  - Per tier: `every_floor_holds(h.deck_size, json!({ "manaCap": h.mana_cap }), None, None, SEEDS)`.
  - The same with `json!({ "manaCap": h.mana_cap, "banned": [], "gatedSets": [] })`.
- `r4784000_every_deck_the_quality_gates_deal_holds_the_units_floor`
  - Setup: `use jackioh_ai::{AI_GATE, AI_GATE_BUDGET, Matchup, fixture_game_config, game_config};` and `register_cards();`.
  - Loop: for `matchup in Matchup::ALL`, `n in 1..=AI_GATE.full_seeds[*matchup]`, over both `game_config(*matchup, n, AI_GATE_BUDGET, AI_GATE.seed_series)` and `fixture_game_config(…same…)`, and both seats `config.decks.0`/`.1`.
  - Assert `units_in(deck) >= floor_of(deck.len() as i32, AI_DECK.min_unit_share)`, with a message naming `config.seed`, the seat, the count and the deck.
- `r4784000_a_book_deck_holds_the_units_floor_on_every_seed_and_a_card_drawn_again_takes_no_extra_rng_draw`
  - `register_cards();` and `let book = options(json!({ "theme": "Book" }));`.
  - For `n in 1..=SEEDS`, seed `format!("r4784000:book:{n}")`: `let mut rng = create_rng(&seed, 0); let deck = build_ai_deck(&mut rng, DECK_SIZE, &book);`.
  - Assert the units floor at `DECK_SIZE`, and `assert_eq!(rng.cursor(), DECK_SIZE as u32, "{seed}")`.
- The pin test (step 7) proves passing decks do not move.

## Done when

- [ ] Steps 1–14 done. `narrow_unleaned` is unchanged and `narrow_leaning`'s output is unchanged.
- [ ] All `deck::` tests pass, including the 5-pin test with no other pin edited. `ai_slow` and `b28_b31` pass.
- [ ] fmt, clippy, `spec check` and `patches check` are clean, and `classify --claims` passes with no fragment.
- [ ] The harness checks (cargo tests with the wire diff empty, web tests) are green.
- [ ] The PR body says:
  - none of the existing pins moved;
  - only below-floor decks are re-dealt (the numbers in R4784000);
  - the 16 `gate:v3` decks;
  - the decisions below.

Decisions taken (record them in the PR):
- Same-roll redraw (no extra draw) chosen over a joint narrowing via `narrow_leaning`, which would re-deal passing seeds too.
- Redraw chosen over an extra rng draw, which would shift the cursor.
- No gate re-measurement.
- One Book pin added.

## Risks

- **Determinism:** the change uses only arrays and `Vec`s, no new rng draw and no hash collections, so purity (rule 4) holds. A redraw must reuse `roll`; never call `rng.next()` twice.
- **Leaning decks:** `floor_takes` must give exactly `narrow_leaning`'s old output. The leaning tests (`r1370_*`, `r1390_*`) guard this.
- **Deploy window:** a practice game on an affected seed that started before deploy and is claimed after it fails the claim re-deal. Kept replays hold their setup. The window is tiny (about 3% of themed AI decks) and the same as any deck-builder change.
- **Gates:** 16 `gate:v3` and 22 tuning decks re-deal. The per-PR smoke's game 4 p1 (the random policy's deck) moves; it passed on the prototype, as did the daily `b29_b31`/`b30_b31` and `r186_giga_glowy`.
- **Cost:** dealing time rises about 50% for themed unleaned decks (0.35 ms per deck in release); unthemed decks skip the check.

## Open questions

None blocking. Should the owner want R4513000's measured rates re-measured on the new tuning deals, that is a separate gate run.

All four new tests go in `crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs`, module `r1370_a_deck_that_leans_on_a_set`.

- `r4784000_without_a_lean_set_every_theme_keeps_its_floor_and_the_units_floor_on_every_deck_at_every_tier`

- `r4784000_without_a_lean_set_a_rolled_theme_or_none_keeps_the_units_floor_on_every_deck_at_every_tier`
  - Per tier: `every_floor_holds(h.deck_size, json!({ "manaCap": h.mana_cap }), None, None, SEEDS)`.

- `r4784000_every_deck_the_quality_gates_deal_holds_the_units_floor`
  - Setup: `use jackioh_ai::{AI_GATE, AI_GATE_BUDGET, Matchup, fixture_game_config, game_config};` and `register_cards();`.
  - Loop: for `matchup in Matchup::ALL`, `n in 1..=AI_GATE.full_seeds[*matchup]`, over both `game_config(*matchup, n, AI_GATE_BUDGET, AI_GATE.seed_series)` and `fixture_game_config(…same…)`, and both seats `config.decks.0`/`.1`.

  - none of the existing pins moved;

  - the 16 `gate:v3` decks;
  - the decisions below.

Decisions taken (record them in the PR):
- Same-roll redraw (no extra draw) chosen over a joint narrowing via `narrow_leaning`, which would re-deal passing seeds too.
- Redraw chosen over an extra rng draw, which would shift the cursor.
- No gate re-measurement.
- One Book pin added.

## Risks

- **Determinism:** the change uses only arrays and `Vec`s, no new rng draw and no hash collections, so purity (rule 4) holds. A redraw must reuse `roll`; never call `rng.next()` twice.
- **Leaning decks:** `floor_takes` must give exactly `narrow_leaning`'s old output. The leaning tests (`r1370_*`, `r1390_*`) guard this.
- **Deploy window:** a practice game on an affected seed that started before deploy and is claimed after it fails the claim re-deal. Kept replays hold their setup. The window is tiny (about 3% of themed AI decks) and the same as any deck-builder change.
- **Gates:** 16 `gate:v3` and 22 tuning decks re-deal. The per-PR smoke's game 4 p1 (the random policy's deck) moves; it passed on the prototype, as did the daily `b29_b31`/`b30_b31` and `r186_giga_glowy`.
- **Cost:** dealing time rises about 50% for themed unleaned decks (0.35 ms per deck in release); unthemed decks skip the check.

## Open questions

None blocking. Should the owner want R4513000's measured rates re-measured on the new tuning deals, that is a separate gate run.
